mapping.name: Hive
mapping.description: Each row exposes a raw Windows Registry value with hive and key path, value name, type, data, key LastWrite time, security metadata, and parse errors where present. Use it for low-level configuration and provenance analysis when no specialized mapping applies. LastWrite is key-level, not a timestamp for each individual value.
mapping.short_description: Shows raw Windows Registry keys and values with modification times, data types, owners, and access controls.
